 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage** suggests that the subject is physically present at the breakfast table.**
 
• The use of **"at" correctly indicates the location **where the narrator's observation takes place.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 1 is '**At**'.

Complete Passage:** **__*__**At **__the breakfast table the next morning, there was no sign of my wife. I presumed she was sleeping late, but Gladolia, upon being questioned, only shook her head, mumbled something, and turned the whites of her eyes up to the ceiling. I was glad when the meal was finished and hurried to the library for another try at that story.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'On' **might imply being on top of the table, which can be misleading in the context of eating breakfast.
 
• **'Above' **would suggest being physically higher than the table, which does not fit the context.
 
• **'Upon'** typically implies a level of formal or old-fashioned usage, usually introducing a more specific action or event immediately following, which does not apply here.
